title: Ray Handley, ex-Giants head coach who won two Super Bowls as assistant, dead at 81

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Ray Handley, ex-Giants head coach who won two Super Bowls as assistant, dead at 81
sources.description: Ray Handley, former Giants head coach and two-time Super Bowl-winning assistant, died last week, the team announced with confirmation from his nephew.
